module: History of the player's insurance events in career (claims, private repairs, renewals, contract changes…). Each entry has a type, a title, effects (for example {type='money', changedBy=-amount}), the name of the insurance concerned, an optional text, free data (other) and the os.time() time. The module also provides totals used for the insurance statistics. The data is saved by the insurance module via getPlHistory/setPlHistory.
notes: Entry types used by the totals: 'insuranceRepairClaim', 'privateRepair', 'insuranceRenewed', 'insuranceChanged'.

getHistoryTotalDetails (internal) increments totalCount once per 'money' effect (and not once per entry): an entry with several money effects counts several times, an entry without a money effect does not count.
The money total uses the absolute value of changedBy.
getTotalInsuranceRepairDeductiblesPaid reads entry.other.deductible and getDamageCostCoveredByInsurance reads entry.other.vehDamagePrice; these fields must be provided in other when adding.
buildPlHistory returns a copy sorted from most recent to oldest and adds a date field formatted os.date('%c').

addToPlHistory.desc: Adds an entry to the history with the current time (os.time()).

data.desc: Table with type, title, effects, concernedInsuranceName, overrideText, other.

buildPlHistory.desc: Builds the history list for the UI: deep copy sorted from most recent to oldest, with a readable date.

returns.desc: List of entries with an extra date field.

getPlHistory.desc: Returns the raw history table (for saving).

setPlHistory.desc: Replaces the history (save loading); a nil value clears it.

getInsuranceClaimsCount.desc: Number of repairs covered by an insurance (money effects of the 'insuranceRepairClaim' entries).

getNonInsuranceRepairsCount.desc: Number of repairs paid without insurance ('privateRepair' entries).

getTotalPremiumPaid.desc: Total premiums paid: renewals ('insuranceRenewed') plus contract changes ('insuranceChanged').

getTotalInsuranceRepairDeductiblesPaid.desc: Sum of the deductibles paid on repair claims.

getTotalPrivateRepairsPaid.desc: Total spent on repairs without insurance.

getDamageCostCoveredByInsurance.desc: Sum of the damage costs (vehDamagePrice) of the repair claims, i.e. the value of the damage covered.
